end.summary:
Practised safe water storage using clean, covered containers.
Named using a matka and ladle/tap to take drinking water.
Explained that hands, dust, and mosquitoes can make water dirty.
Suggested cleaning containers regularly and avoiding water waste.
Teach-back was not passed; one of three attempts was unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Pari practised storing drinking water in a clean, covered container and taking it with a ladle rather than putting hands in. They explained several reasons for covering water and also suggested using leftover water for plants and fixing leaking taps. Asha noted that the same point was repeated across some responses; practising one complete answer in order—container, cover, cleaning, and ladle—may help at home.
